answer: Each identity is one vertex in the work graph, with a 90-credit vault bond. Each tide it shows two vertex-disjoint paths to two anchors, each from jobs for distinct clients. Auditors recompute paths; a shared vertex breaks disjointness and burns both bonds. A fake needs two routes at 90 each, and the k-th fake needs two new routes, since one vertex cannot serve two identities. 1,000 fakes cost 180,000 plus 90,000 locked, no bulk discount. Rented paths fail: a rented vertex already lies on another path, so the tide audit burns the vault bond. Honest identities pay 180 and lock 90.
